title: DBT definition and purpose

title: Standard comprehensive outpatient DBT components
content: The standard outpatient DBT model described by ABCT includes weekly individual therapy, weekly skills training, as-needed between-session consultation and a weekly therapist consultation team. A programme missing components should be described as an adaptation rather than automatically called comprehensive DBT.
